name: Wikipedia "Recession" Attention & Pageview Index
description: Daily pageviews of the English Wikipedia article 'Recession' over 5 years, tracking retail curiosity as a leading proxy for economic sentiment and market volatility.

etl.script: WITH raw_data AS (SELECT UNNEST(items) AS item FROM read_json_auto('https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/metrics/pageviews/per-article/en.wikipedia/all-access/all-agents/Recession/daily/20190101/20240101')) SELECT CAST(strptime(item.timestamp, '%Y%m%d%H') AS TIMESTAMP) AS date, CAST(item.views AS FLOAT32) AS views FROM raw_data;
